prompts.audit.json.message:
Continue as a source-grounded independent auditor. Do not read guides, condition mappings, preferences, initial drafts, other raw files, or history outside the specified evidence. No browsing or agents. This audit checks anonymous final prose plus separate prose-only readers' reconstructions, NOT preferred style. Sources (and original PDFs for table layout):
{WORKSPACE}/inputs/P01.txt
{WORKSPACE}/inputs/P13.txt
Original PDFs and extraction metadata are sources/<id>.pdf and metadata/<id>.json under this workspace. Use the permitted extraction segments to ground claims; PDF layout can disambiguate equations and tables, not silently expand the writers' inputs with excluded sections. If a true claim has support only outside those inputs, record that grounding limit without calling it a false numerical claim.
Frozen grounding anchors:
{WORKSPACE}/anchors/P01.json
{WORKSPACE}/anchors/P13.json
Anonymous audit packet:
{WORKSPACE}/packets/audit_D1.json
Inspect all 36 texts, their readings, and original table/experiment/guarantee conditions. Anchors are grounding aids, not a mandatory list or answer-key wording; judge the paragraph's selected function. Fidelity: pass if claims and necessary boundaries supported; concern if consequential ambiguous scope/unsupported implication; fail if materially false/invented. For the reader's central-relation recovery and consequential scope recovery give integer 0 (absent/wrong), 1 (partial), or 2 (recoverable, source-supported and text-supported).
